about_the_game:
Over 60 Tracks of Dev-Driven Bangers, Beats & Background Bliss

Step into the sound of GameOn! with this extensive and lovingly crafted soundtrack — featuring 60+ original tracks that span the full emotional arc of game development: from late-night coding crunches to euphoric launch celebrations.

Whether you’re looking for ambient chill music to work to, or want to dive into fully produced songs with heartfelt lyrics about the life of a developer, this collection delivers.
